blocks.text: LOS ANGELES — Guard Austin Reaves and center Walker Kessler will miss the streaking Los Angeles Lakers’ next game against Charlotte due to injuries. The Lakers ruled out Reaves for a second straight game Monday night before they host the Hornets on Tuesday night. Los Angeles has won seven straight games.
